descriptionMarkdown:
WIP BY ME WIP BY ME WIP BY ME WIP BY ME WIP BY ME 

Basic space age Nauvis pre-megabase base / beat-the-game-base. 

Requires merging chests, Cybersyn, and Cybersyn combinator mods.
If you do not have merging chests, you will have to fix all buffer chests at all train dropoff stations, chests in the uranium processing block, and science pack buffer chests. 
If you do not have Cybersyn you will have to fix the train stations and routes to run off of train interrupts instead of the mod.

300-ish SPM of: red, green, blue, military.
180 SPM of purple/yellow.  
Large bot mall. Add more machines if something is not already there.
Entirely nuclear powered.
4 Rocket Silos with bot feeding for building of ships and other planets.

Requires:
Water and oil inputs, train pickup stations for the following: iron ore, copper ore, uranium ore, coal, and stone.
1k-ish logistics robots minimum to be safe. 

Contains no defenses or defensive processing aside from military science packs. 

Contains no beacons, modules, blue belts, or anything from other planets. Rail segments were made by Nilaus.
Ratios are close, but not 100% perfect.
title: Nauvis Belt Base
